verdict.rationale: Box's developer metadata guide documents custom key-value data on files and folders, defined through metadata templates and instances and retrievable through metadata queries. The base API reference and the AI Extract flow that writes searchable metadata support programmatic set-and-query use. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint-level documentation or examples for creating instances and running metadata queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API

citations.quote: Define and store custom key-value data on files and folders using metadata templates, instances, cascade policies, and queries.
Metadata allows users and applications to define and store custom data associated with files and folders.
Box AI Extract pulls vendor, dates, and totals into searchable metadata.
